---

## Load libraries

```{r}
library(elodea)
library(here)
library(readr)
```

## Set directory

```{r}
processed_dir <- here::here("data", "processed")
```

### Combine taxa and distributions files

```{r}
taxa_files <- list.files(processed_dir, pattern = "taxa.csv$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
distributions_files <- list.files(processed_dir, pattern = "distributions.csv$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)

taxa <-
  do.call(rbind, purrr::map(taxa_files, read.csv)) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    taxonKey = NA_character_,
    taxonID = NA_character_
    ) %>% 
  dplyr::distinct()
distributions <-
  do.call(rbind, purrr::map(distributions_files, read.csv)) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(taxonKey = NA_character_) 
```

```{r}
directory <- here::here("data", "Europe")
taxa_path <- file.path(directory, "taxa.csv")
distributions_path <- file.path(directory, "distributions.csv")
 if (!dir.exists(directory)) {
    dir.create(directory, recursive = TRUE)
  }
readr::write_csv(taxa, taxa_path, na = "")
readr::write_csv(distributions, distributions_path, na = "")
```
